prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Premium sculptural 3D advertising asset for Sorted, a UK money-planning app. Square opaque image on a pale cool slate #f0f2f7 studio background. Tell a story of a proposed transfer between two of the person's own bank accounts, with a phone showing the plan. A confident calm financial advertising world, no AI/chat imagery.
Place a single upright front-facing silver smartphone at x=36% to 70%, y=8% to 86%; parallel vertical sides, clean blank pale slate #f0f2f7 screen, black camera pill at top, aluminium edge and real thickness. Keep its whole upper screen visible.
A substantial satin indigo directional ribbon makes a clear LEFT-TO-RIGHT path across the foreground below the phone's midpoint, from a teal ceramic bank pedestal at x=14%, y=67% to a blue ceramic bank pedestal at x=87%, y=76%. One clear sculpted arrowhead points to the RIGHT, no loops or reverse direction. The route is a physical raised path, gently bent around the phone's base, not a thin glowing line. The two small bank pedestals have abstract architecture with three columns and a roof, no logos. Deliberately leave x=3% to 36%, y=43% to 62% and x=66% to 97%, y=59% to 76% clear for source/destination account labels to be composited later. The lower central route has a small unmarked white ceramic token that can receive a £120 label, no currency drawn by you.
Photorealistic stylised 3D product campaign, convincing material, pale porcelain, brushed metal and soft shadows, restrained indigo #4f46e5, teal and blue. No violet or gradient, no money raining, no gold coins, no speech bubbles, no question marks, no checkmarks, no completed-transfer imagery. No words, letters, numbers, logos or interface anywhere. The app only suggests a move; there must be no suggestion the transfer has automatically completed. Upper margins quiet. Every object fully in frame.
note: Blank-screen scene. Real app components and campaign annotation composed separately in browser; no automated transfers.
